why: Send Success Message to Telegram and Email Workflow Stats take their targets from $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID and $env.EMAIL_ADDRESS_JOE, which the template leaves to the user's environment. The bench sets both as env on the n8n container (and lifts n8n 2.x's default $env block). The runtime keeps $env blocked by design, so the Claude half carries the same two values as step overrides, the answer a user gives for a step that reads $env. Placeholder fills only: no logic changes.
